purpose: Define MeritCore as the authority that calculates points from accepted merit evidence while preserving evidence provenance and preventing Project decomposition from multiplying points.

value.calculation_rule: MeritCore calculates points from accepted merit evidence according to explicit policy.
value.backend_rule: Backend/domain operations may write merit evidence; MeritCore owns point calculation.
value.evidence_rule: Every calculated point result traces to accepted evidence and exact identity.
value.time_rule: Evidence may retain Project-linked week/hour atoms.
value.nonmultiplication_rule: Splitting Projects or time atoms cannot multiply the same underlying merit evidence.
value.broker_rule: FreeMarket/broker relevance weighting is not a global MeritCore point-weighting rule.
value.recompute_rule: Policy/version changes require explicit recomputation/version provenance rather than silent history rewrite.

invariants.rule: MeritCore derives human competence/trust history from explicit identity-bound Project evidence; identities, evidence, recommendations, points, Tier and broker relevance remain separate semantic dimensions.

references.purpose: Points may consume Project-linked time evidence.
